briefing: Markets turned risk_off today with NASDAQ down 1.5% and S&P 500 down 0.7%, so no new candidates were screened. We're holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy into weakness.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Risk-off' describes a market mood where investors pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safer holdings or cash. On days like this, it's often smarter to hold your existing positions and skip new purchases rather than chase falling prices.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」（避險情緒）是指投資者在市況不明朗時，傾向減持增長股等高風險資產，轉而持有較安全的資產或現金。在這種日子，持有現有倉位、暫緩新買入，通常比追逐下跌股價更明智。

market_education.summary_en: Broad weakness hit tech-heavy indices harder than the overall market today, with NASDAQ falling 1.5% versus a smaller 0.7% drop in the S&P 500, suggesting growth and momentum names were sold off more aggressively than defensive or value-oriented stocks. This pattern typically reflects investors rotating out of higher-risk, higher-valuation positions during periods of uncertainty. No specific news headlines were available in today's feed to pinpoint the exact catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市偏弱，科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌1.5%，跌幅明顯大於標普500指數的0.7%，反映投資者在不確定市況下，傾向沽售估值較高、風險較大的增長股，轉而持有防守性或價值型股票。今日未有具體新聞標題可供引用以確定確實的下跌原因。
